tasks.instruction: Open the Browser area in the local Week 4 testbed.
tasks.success_criteria: The Browser area is visible and marked open.

tasks.instruction: Search for 'week4 safe search' in the local testbed Browser area.
tasks.success_criteria: The result area displays 'Search result: week4 safe search'.

tasks.instruction: Open week4-demo.txt from the local testbed Files area.
tasks.success_criteria: The Files area displays week4-demo.txt and WEEK4_DEMO_READY.

tasks.instruction: Send 'week4 test message' to the in-memory local testbed inbox.
tasks.success_criteria: The local inbox displays exactly 'week4 test message'.

actions.summary: Message sent to local testbed inbox

tasks.instruction: Close only the local Week 4 testbed application.
tasks.success_criteria: The testbed window exits and unrelated applications remain open.
